## Parental OpControl 0.17.12

- **Delete all chats** and **Delete chat** now confirm exactly what was removed ("Chats deleted: … · Messages deleted: …"). The chats, their messages, titles and summaries are removed; the learner profile is kept.
- The Luna app now refreshes its chat list every time Luna opens and whenever the home screen is shown, so chats deleted by a parent disappear without restarting the app.
- Opening a chat that no longer exists now returns to the home screen with a short "This chat was removed" note instead of an empty or broken chat.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
